title: Restricted Standard WOFOST One-Day Rate Evaluator Readiness & Provider Boundary
goal: Determine and qualify the smallest source-bound parameter, state-view, forcing and accepted-process boundary required to produce the F-WOF26 one-day rate packet without legacy globals, persistent rate workspace, calendar coupling or unrelated WOFOST options.

prepare_assimilation.timing: after F-WOF26 candidate-local day-start Tmin-history preparation and before soil-water substeps
prepare_assimilation.reason: B1.10 assimilation computes gross assimilation before the soil-water substeps; preserving this phase boundary keeps future same-window oxygen/root-respiration coupling possible even though that option is excluded from the first profile

finalize_rates.timing: after accepted IQROT/IPTRA are frozen for the crop window
finalize_rates.required_output: complete event-local wofost_one_day_rate_packet_t for the admitted profile
finalize_rates.reason: water stress affects GASS, leaf death and GLAI, so these rates cannot be finalized before accepted-process aggregation

architectural_rules: the provider receives explicit immutable parameter DTOs or references, never legacy module globals
the provider receives read-only crop state/views and may not mutate committed or candidate crop state
all rates and algebraic intermediates remain call-local or worker scratch
solar geometry is explicit forcing; the provider does not call ASTRO(daynr,...)
the provider has no file I/O, weather cursor, calendar counter, MODFLOW or Richards-solver dependency
F-WOF26 remains the only owner of structural state integration and cohort mutation
accepted IQROT/IPTRA lineage remains a runtime/F-KT precondition and is not recreated inside the rate evaluator
reference-specific GLAIEXP carryover is read from the owner/reference view only when pre-event LAIEXP>=6; the producer must not invent a fresh rate in that regime
rate_packet_fields_to_resolve: leaf_stress_death_rate excluding lifespan death handled structurally by F-WOF26
forbidden: implementing broad production WOFOST rate physics before the input/parameter boundary is reconciled
copying WOFOST_param or WOFOST_rates legacy layout wholesale into persistent per-column state
calling ASTRO from the crop rate evaluator
using plant_interface, atmosphere_interface, MOD_integral or variables globals as new production dependencies
silently enabling IDSL=2, nutrients, oxygen, SWRD=3, soybean, grass or potential-shadow behavior
